central_question: What will the USD spot price of Bitcoin (Coinbase/Kraken composite) be at the official close of 31 December 2027?

situation_brief.current_situation: BTC trades at ~$81,225.62 (Coinbase FRED close, 2026-10-22) with Kraken at $81,261.00 (2026-10-23), about 35% below the halving-epoch high of $126,080 set October 6, 2025, after a ~54% drawdown to ~$58,000 in June 2026 and a ~31% 90-day recovery. US spot ETFs hold $108.01B net assets with +$57.78B cumulative inflows but near-flat 2026 flows (~+$1B YTD). 30-day realized vol is ~20-23%.
situation_brief.context: The April 2024 halving epoch topped in October 2025; Galaxy finds every prior cycle bottomed 12-13 months after its top, placing the decisive window inside the horizon. Macro is neutral-tight: Fed funds 3.875% (2026-09), SEP median projects 4.1% through end-2027, 10-year Treasury 4.989%, M2 +5.659% YoY, VIX 15.78-19.03. CME BTCZ27 (Dec 2027) last traded 89,885.00 USD, ~8.7% annualized contango.
situation_brief.dynamics: ETF marginal buyer shifted from hedge funds (top-40 cut IBIT 28% by Q4 2025) to advisors, sovereigns and endowments; Q3 2026 inflows rebounded to +$6.3B after months of outflows. On-chain regime flipped to re-accumulation: exchange reserves fell to 2.67M BTC, dormant supply growing, but short-term holder churn rising (STH/LTH ratio 14.2%) and an overhead cost-basis band capped September highs. SEC substitutes rulemaking (Regulation Crypto Assets, custody) for stalled CLARITY legislation; GENIUS Act licensing starts January 18, 2027; Strategic Bitcoin Reserve has no purchase power.

scenarios.name: Institutional reflation
scenarios.narrative: ETF inflows reaccelerate and the Fed eases into 2027, carrying BTC above its prior cycle high ($126,080) and ending 2027 above $150,000; prior: post-halving-year gains in 3 of 4 epochs.

scenarios.name: Range-bound digestion
scenarios.narrative: BTC chops between roughly $60,000 and $110,000 through 2027 as ETF flows stall and macro liquidity stays neutral, ending within ±30% of the current ~$81,000; prior: 12-month moves within one sigma (~68%) at ~40-50% annualized vol.

scenarios.name: Post-cycle bear
scenarios.narrative: The 2025 cycle top holds and the historical 70-80% drawdown pattern replays in muted form, with BTC ending 2027 between $35,000 and $60,000; prior: drawdowns of >60% followed every prior cycle peak.

scenarios.name: Liquidity shock
scenarios.narrative: A recession or credit event forces risk-off liquidation, briefly taking BTC under $30,000 before a recovery, ending 2027 near $40,000; prior: US recession began in about 1 of 6.5 years since 1948.
